assets.name: Likelihood Chart
assets.purpose: Anchor chart of impossible/possible/certain. Used in Lessons 1, 2, 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait. Three vertical sections.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait likelihood anchor chart for a Grade 2 classroom, B&W line art. Three sections: IMPOSSIBLE (red border, examples: pig fly, snow July), POSSIBLE (yellow border, examples: rain, smile), CERTAIN (green border, examples: sun rises, lunch).
